state:
**Goal `var-array-literal` — Stages 2 and 3 are on disk, and Stage 4 is next.** `var $ids = [1, 2, 3];`
is `array<int>`; every other literal is `E0414` with the declaration to write (decision record 0252,
`rule:types/var-inference`). The synthesis is `synthesize_array_literal` in
`crates/nvs-types/src/expr/literals.rs`, called only through `var_array_literal` in
`crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs`.

Stage 3: a write that misses a `var` local's type is the ordinary `E0401` plus a label on the `var` line
and a help naming the widened declaration (`name_the_var_line` in `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/assign.rs`,
reading `LocalScope::var_initializer`). The scalar `var $n = 1; $n = 2.5;` gets the same help. The inlay
hint already showed `: array<int>`, and a test pins it. The IR-equality test pins that a `var` literal
lowers as the written type does. The Stage 2 check's drafted test names are now the names in
`crates/nvs-types/tests/locals.rs`. The two missing claims are written as new tests: one element type per
`var` element, and the nullable help.

The perf records for `lang:types` and `lang:expressions` were measured again after the reference
chapters changed. Stage 4 changes `docs/reference/lang/20-types.md` again, so run
`bun nv proofs --record-perf --group lang:types` after it.

items.text: **The new example** — a fourth program beside `docs/examples/lang/types/array-t/01-add-up-a-list-of-prices.nvs:1` that declares three arrays with `var` and prints them, plus its `.out`. Rewrite one existing program in each of the two features to `var` over a literal, and keep one written `array<T>`. A changed `.out` is a finding (goal file § *Stage 4*).

**The attack step** — a new numbered step in `tests/hostile/lang/types/every-binding-has-a-type/01-every-way-a-name-can-be-written-down-at-once.nvs:1`: `var` over a `tainted` and a plain string does not compile (`rule:types/var-inference`).

**The reference and the about pages** — a running fenced program in the `var` section of `docs/reference/lang/20-types.md:1`; `docs/examples/lang/types/array-t/about.md:1` and `docs/examples/lang/types/every-binding-has-a-type/about.md:1` inside their word bands; the `covers:` markers on `tests/conformance/lang/var-infers-an-array-literal-whose-elements-have-one-type.nvst:1` name both features; then `bun nv reference`, `bun nv proofs --comments` over the new programs, and `--record-perf --group lang:types`.
